item.description: The View class lacks proper attribute access handling for fields that have names conflicting with built-in methods or attributes. Tests like test_getitem_custom_call and test_base_class_1 fail because signals don't have expected attributes like 'f', 'add', 'do'.
item.contract: View instances must properly handle attribute access for fields that conflict with built-in methods. When accessing a field via attribute (e.g., v.f) where 'f' is a field name, it should return the field value regardless of whether it conflicts with built-in methods. The __getattr__ method should not interfere with legitimate field access.

item.description: The _convert_to_int method in Layout class doesn't properly validate reset values for complex layouts like StructLayout and UnionLayout. Tests like test_construct_signal_reset and test_signal_reset fail due to improper reset value validation.
item.contract: Layout classes must properly validate reset values for all layout types. The _convert_to_int method should correctly validate reset values and throw appropriate TypeError messages for invalid reset values (e.g., dictionaries for UnionLayout, non-constant values).

item.description: View class does not properly handle field access errors with meaningful error messages. Tests like test_attr_wrong_missing and test_attr_wrong_reserved fail because AttributeError messages don't match expected formats.
item.contract: View instances must provide meaningful error messages when accessing non-existent fields or reserved fields. When accessing a non-existent field, it should provide suggestions for similar field names. When accessing a reserved field name (starting with underscore), it should explicitly state that reserved names can only be accessed via indexing.

item.description: Layout constant initialization support is incomplete for various data types. Tests like test_const_wrong and test_const_field_shape_castable fail because constant initialization doesn't properly handle various types and error messages.
item.contract: Layout classes must support proper constant initialization with correct error handling for invalid inputs. The const() method should accept valid mappings/sequences and raise appropriate TypeError/ValueError with descriptive messages for invalid inputs.

item.description: View class does not properly handle invalid indexing operations. Tests like test_index_wrong_missing and test_index_wrong_struct_dynamic fail because the error messages for invalid indexing don't match expected formats.
item.contract: View instances must provide clear error messages for invalid indexing operations. When trying to index with a non-existent field name, it should raise KeyError with the specific field name. When trying to index array layouts with values instead of integers, it should provide a clear error message.
